Headline_ing: Israel Public Broadcasting Corporation has come under fire from angry listeners after broadcasting interview with former Australian PM Abbott. During interview recorded while his home state New South Wales was fighting terrifying bushfires Abbott denied carbon dioxide was driving global warming.
Headline_esp: La cadena pública israelí de radiodifusión ha recibido duras críticas de oyentes indignados tras la emisión de una entrevista con el ex primer ministro australiano Abbott. Durante la entrevista, grabada mientras su estado natal de Nueva Gales del Sur luchaba contra devastadores incendios forestales, Abbott negó que el dióxido de carbono fuera la causa del calentamiento global.

Headline_ing: Israel Public Broadcasting Corporation has come under fire from angry listeners after broadcasting interview with former Australian PM Abbott. Headline_ing: Israel Public Broadcasting Corporation has come under fire from angry listeners after broadcasting interview with former Australian PM Abbott. During interview recorded while his home state New South Wales was fighting terrifying bushfires Abbott denied carbon dioxide was driving global warming.
Headline_esp: La cadena pública israelí de radiodifusión ha recibido duras críticas de oyentes indignados tras la emisión de una entrevista con el ex primer ministro australiano Abbott. Durante la entrevista, grabada mientras su estado natal de Nueva Gales del Sur luchaba contra devastadores incendios forestales, Abbott negó que el dióxido de carbono fuera la causa del calentamiento global.
